regulatory_history.title: People v. AppLovin Corporation (San Diego Superior Court)
regulatory_history.body: Superior Court of California, County of San Diego
regulatory_history.notes: Brought by the County of San Diego's new Consumer Fairness and Public Protection Division under California's unfair competition and false advertising laws. It alleges inappropriate ads in children's games despite parental controls, and data collected from minors after parents opted out, and seeks injunctive relief.

regulatory_history.title: Stichting The Privacy Collective v. AppLovin Corporation and Adjust GmbH (Amsterdam District Court)
regulatory_history.notes: A collective action under the Dutch WAMCA for people in the Netherlands who used apps with AppLovin's or Adjust's SDKs since 2018, which the foundation puts at 8.5 million or more, about 1.5 million of them minors. It claims breaches of the GDPR and the Dutch Telecommunications Act, and seeks damages and an end to the practices. First court date: 2026-08-26.
